title: KT rolls out dedicated AI line, hitting 800-Gig capacity
content: South Korean operator KT has unveiled an AI-only line to support the large-volume data transfers required by AI data centers.

title: Data center physical infrastructure market grows 27% YOY to $14B in 2Q 2026 – Dell'Oro
content: Delays, not cancellations: permitting emerges as the main near-term risk to the AI data center buildout. #pressrelease

title: Gartner warns AI data center capex is ‘unsustainable’ as $3.5T write-down risk looms
content: The AI data center boom may be headed for a brutal reset, with Gartner warning today’s capex trajectory could trigger trillions in write-downs and wipe out most neoclouds.
